what.en: Item O: the California street address where the business is physically conducted, with its phone number. No P.O. box or private mailbox. Attach a list if there are several California locations.
what.zh: 第O项：在加州实际开展业务的街道地址及电话。不得用邮政信箱或私人信箱。如在加州有多处地点，另附清单。

ifNone.en: Use the California store or worksite address. If the company has no California site yet (for example only remote staff), ask EDD what to enter; never use a mailbox or registered-agent address.
ifNone.zh: 填写加州门店或工作场所地址。若公司在加州尚无任何场所（例如只有远程员工），请先咨询 EDD；切勿使用信箱或注册代理人地址。

what.en: Item P: where EDD sends mail and forms. A P.O. box or private mailbox is fine, and the form has State/Province and Country boxes, so an address abroad is accepted. Tick 'Same as above' if it is the physical address.
what.zh: 第P项：EDD 寄送信件和表格的地址。可用邮政信箱或私人信箱；表格设有“州/省”和“国家”栏，可填境外地址。如与实际地址相同，勾选“Same as above”。

ifNone.en: Use whichever address is read promptly: the California location, a US P.O. box or the head office abroad.
ifNone.zh: 填写能及时查收信件的地址：加州门店、美国邮政信箱或境外总部均可。

what.en: Item S: name, phone, email, relation and address of the person who keeps the EDD account up to date; an outside accountant or agent also files a Power of Attorney (DE 48). No source says where that address must be.
what.zh: 第S项：负责维护 EDD 账户信息的联系人的姓名、电话、邮箱、关系和地址；外部会计师或代理人还须提交授权书（DE 48）。没有资料说明该地址须在何处。

ifNone.en: Use the contact person's own business address in the US; if they only have one abroad, Placetta asks EDD first.
ifNone.zh: 填写联系人在美国的办公地址；若其只有境外地址，Placetta 会先向 EDD 确认。

confirmations.quote: Enter the name, daytime phone number, e-mail address, relation, and address of the person authorized by the ownership to provide the EDD with information

notes: DE 1 Rev. 79 (3-16), its instructions DE 1I, and the parallel EDD forms DE 1NP (nonprofit) and DE 1GS (governmental), whose instructions repeat the same address rules. DE 1 prints a Country box on both item O and item P, but the instructions limit item O to a California street address. owner_info carries no address (name, title, SSN, license only). The EDD registration web page lists 'physical business address and mailing address' but redirects automated reads, so it is not cited.
